items.name: Ink
items.role: The single primary CTA color. Black-near-pure ink that carries every Sign Up pill, every footer CTA, the dark-band polarity-flip. Used as text color throughout…

items.name: Cyan
items.role: A signature mint-cyan used in the brand gradient and inside Geist-system spotlight tokens. Visible inside the hero gradient stops.

items.name: Highlight Pink
items.role: The brand's highlight magenta, used as the high-saturation stop in the preview-gradient pair.

items.name: Violet
items.role: The deep purple used as the start of the preview-gradient and inside developer-console highlights.

items.name: Link Blue
items.role: The brand's primary link color and the legacy --geist-success semantic.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: The pure-white card / dialog / modal surface.

items.name: Canvas Soft
items.role: The default page background — 98 % white. Almost every section sits on this tone.

items.name: Canvas Soft 2
items.role: A slightly deeper inset surface for "code editor inner background", template-card hover states, and dropdown menus.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: 1 px dividers — table rows, card borders, input borders.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: The 500-level gray, used as the slightly-stronger divider on light bands and as the deemphasised text color.

items.name: Ink
items.role: Every heading and body paragraph on light surfaces.

items.name: Body
items.role: Secondary text — sub-headings, body captions, nav-link inactive text, footer column body.

items.name: Mute
items.role: Lowest-priority text — placeholder text, fine print, low-key labels.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: All text on surfaces.

items.name: Success / Link
items.role: The brand's legacy success indicator doubles as the primary link color. Visible underline-on-hover for inline body links.

items.name: Link Deep
items.role: The pressed / visited tone for inline links.

items.name: Link Bg Soft
items.role: Soft pastel blue fill for "what's new" pill banners and informational badges.

items.name: Error
items.role: Validation red for destructive actions and form errors.

items.name: Error Soft
items.role: Soft pastel red for destructive-state backgrounds.

items.name: Error Deep
items.role: Pressed / deep destructive state.

items.name: Warning
items.role: Caution / pending status indicator.

items.name: Warning Soft
items.role: / Warning Deep (#ab570a): Background + pressed variants.

items.name: Develop
items.role: the blue-to-teal pair used to mark the "deploy" / "develop" rhythm.

items.name: Preview
items.role: the violet-to-pink pair used for "preview" surfaces.

items.name: Ship
items.role: the coral-to-amber pair used for "ship" surfaces.
